buildings.name: BRASS & BLADE
buildings.dialogue: A good edge makes the journey home shorter. New stock arrives as you defeat keepers.

buildings.name: THE RINGWORKS
buildings.dialogue: Take a vest before you take a risk. Equip purchases from your satchel.

buildings.name: MOSS & MORTAR
buildings.dialogue: Salves for bruises, tonic for your light. Clearleaf takes care of poison.

buildings.name: THE WARM WINDOW
buildings.dialogue: Your room is always ready. Rest is on the house while the survey guild finds its feet.

buildings.name: THE STILL FLAME
buildings.dialogue: Even a small flame can guide someone home. I can lift the poison from your blood.

npcs.name: Tamsin
npcs.dialogue: The board is just north of the fountain. Accept a commission, then press B to open your atlas. A chart is yours for good.

npcs.name: Rook
npcs.dialogue: I keep returning to the same old vault. Once you know where its best chests are, it feels like an old friend.
